title: Impact of DMEK on visual quality in patients with Fuchs’ endothelial dystrophy

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: 'licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License', link https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

indication: Fuchs endothelial dystrophy without previous corneal surgery; 22 pseudophakic DMEK and 29 triple DMEK (DMEK combined with cataract surgery) (Table 1)

groups.description: DMEK with surgeon-prepared grafts (Melles technique), 7.75 or 8.0 mm, glass-cartridge injection through a 2.2-mm incision, 20% SF6 fill of 80-90%, inferior peripheral iridectomy, face-up positioning 3-4 days, standardized ofloxacin, pilocarpine and steroid regimen; rebubbling in 20 patients; prospective institutional case series, Goethe-University Frankfurt, February 2018 to February 2019, one eye per patient

exclusions.what: Ranges in parentheses inside the Table 2 CCT cells
exclusions.reason: Ranges are not admissible; only the leading mean is read

exclusions.what: Table 2 rows CDVA, ECD, CAant, KmF, CApost, KmB, Q post and corneal densitometry
Tables 3 and 4 (median questionnaire scores; Spearman correlations)
exclusions.reason: Medians and correlation coefficients, not corneal thickness

notes: Role: standard DMEK without an investigational agent; single control-role group.

Four patients needing secondary keratoplasty (3 repeat DMEK for persistent graft dysfunction, 1 PK for stromal scarring) were excluded from the postoperative analysis and 41 patients completed the 3-month visit (Results); postoperative means are therefore conditional on graft survival and follow-up. n = 51 is the number at the reference.
Triple DMEK (combined phacoemulsification and IOL) in 29 of 51 eyes; results are not reported separately by combined versus DMEK-only surgery; procedure context dmek.
Table 2 footnote: 4 patients were excluded from CDVA because of extracorneal visual limitations; this concerns CDVA only.

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT (Table 2 row 'CCT (µm)', column 'Preoperative'); Pentacam AXL Scheimpflug tomography (Methods)
series.notes: Table 2 columns Preoperative, 1 month, 3 months; cells are mean ± SD (range) per caption and only the leading mean is read; per-visit n not reported (41 patients completed the 3-month visit)
